'''"The Loop"''' was an ellipse-shaped passenger line running around the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tal'cara]], on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

The Loop encircled an area housing several corporations and the market. The circuit had eleven above-ground stations, the westernmost of which was the [[Kothlis Starport]].<ref name="guide" />

[[Raynor Mining Enterprises]] had installed an underground tunnel system under the [[metal/Legends|metallic]] platform on which they would build a city. When the plan was abandoned and the Bothans bought the planet as a colony, they completed the city, made modifications to the track, and bought three [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Model 8-X Unirail]] vehicles for its two lines.<ref name="guide" />

A fare was one [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] worth.<ref name="guide" />
